subject.title: fix(mattermost): bound websocket handshake waits at 30s

question: Should Mattermost’s production WebSocket client adopt a fixed 30-second handshake timeout before reconnecting?
rationale: Source, upstream contract, tests, and standalone proof establish correctness, but only the Mattermost owner can confirm that the fixed fail-closed threshold is appropriate for supported self-hosted servers and proxy topologies.

options.title: Accept the 30-second boundary
options.body: Merge the private fixed timeout because it matches established sibling behavior and prevents one stalled upgrade from pinning Mattermost indefinitely.

options.title: Choose a different fixed boundary
options.body: Revise the private constant and rerun the same stalled-peer proof if Mattermost deployments require more than 30 seconds, without adding public configuration prematurely.

recommendation.title: Accept the 30-second boundary
recommendation.body: Merge the private fixed timeout because it matches established sibling behavior and prevents one stalled upgrade from pinning Mattermost indefinitely.

likelyOwner.reason: The repository explicitly identifies this person with Mattermost ownership, making them the strongest available decision owner for the channel’s connection policy.
